title: Tried every. habit. tracker on market. Picked this one.
body:
What I really like about it: 
- no limits on how many habits I can add (like why, Streaks??)
- Weekly tasks left my sight for the day after I've done it for the day (Productive, take note!)
- Allowing going above and beyond with weekly tasks after the minimum reps achieved. COOL. 

ok my ADHD brain burns out. Will edit when I think of more about why this is THE ONE for me.
author: Wanderlane

title: Awesome app!
body: Looking forward for more features! It'll be good if the goal can be set to have different values for different weeks. Another feature would be to introduce break system where the streak will not be gone. E.g. I might go for one week holiday and not able to complete certain goal and don't want my streak to be lost. It's also not accurate to just tick the goal as achieved if I'm on holiday.

title: Nice interface, easy to use
body: One of the goal tracker apps with the nicest interface and range of analytics (eg by milestone, average times per week, etc) thus far. Looking forward to the bug fixes for the crash that happens every time a new goal is created. Would be wonderful if it allows a note or memo for the created goal and a passcode. Overall, still good! Did not regret this purchase which is reasonably priced. Thumbs up for the good work.
